prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a parking lot collision. The patient had 7 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1374; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented for evaluation following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and reported headache, dizziness, and difficulty concentrating. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the nature and force of the impact. Over seven visits, care proceeded along a typical course for mild concussion, including symptom monitoring, graduated activity guidance, and cognitive rest recommendations. Symptom frequency and severity decreased steadily as the patient improved, and visit intervals were lengthened accordingly. Examination revealed some findings that support the diagnosis, including mild balance deficit and tenderness over the occipital region, while other neurological and orthopedic tests were within normal limits. No prior injury to the head or neck is known to this provider. Billing records reflect a single charge for each service rendered, with no duplicated entries. The patient was discharged from active care with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
